profile.name: Robin Ahmed
profile.objective: Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building production and portfolio web applications using Angular, React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server. Experienced in REST API integration, Zod validation, authentication and authorization, responsive UI development, and end-to-end full-stack workflows. Focused on clean, maintainable, scalable applications and effective collaboration across development and QA teams.

experience.title: Software Developer
points: Build and maintain production-level Angular features using reusable components, services, and modules while following team coding standards.
Integrate REST APIs and handle data flow between frontend and backend.
Contribute to backend development using .NET Core and Entity Framework Core (EF Core), including API development, business logic implementation, and database operations.
Collaborate with senior developers, QA, and team members using Git.
Gain experience with real-world software development lifecycle (SDLC).

projects.name: GearUp
projects.description: A full-stack Next.js rental platform where customers can browse and rent sports/outdoor equipment, providers manage gear and rental orders, and administrators oversee users, inventory, and rental activity.
features: Role-based authentication with Customer, Provider, and Admin access control using JWT and HTTP-only authentication cookies.
Equipment browsing, keyword search, category/price filtering, sorting, rental date and quantity selection, and rental order tracking.
Provider and Admin dashboards for inventory management, rental lifecycle management, user moderation, and Stripe payment processing.

features: Secure user authentication with email/password and Google (JWT-based).
Report, browse, and manage lost or found items with image uploads.
Search and filter items by category, location, and posting date.

projects.name: AssessFlow
projects.description: Role-based recruitment assessment platform for assessment creation, candidate attempts, evaluation, reporting, and payment-based credit management.

Built recruiter workflows for company management, problem creation, assessment setup, candidate invitations, submission review, manual evaluation, reports, billing, and payments.
Skill, budget, and deadline-based filtering for task and freelancer discovery.
